auditor_jane: Hi team — during SOC2 fieldwork we need a compact evidence bundle that shows an RBAC change provenance + KMS envelope decrypts for a simulated incident. Required: applied RBAC snapshot, terraform/git diff, KMS decrypt events with key/version, and linkage to any vuln ticket.
sanjay: Got it. We can produce a sanitized tarball with: `kubectl get rolebinding -o yaml`, apiserver audit slice, terraform plan diff, and CloudKMS decrypt log lines.
lee: For KMS we'll map prod key `projects/redwood/.../cryptoKeys/llm-wrap` to a staging keyring. I'll include key version IDs in logs.
auditor_jane: Also need principal identity (OIDC subject or email) in logs and a signed checksum (GPG) for non-repudiation.
nada: Plan: capture applied state + managedFields, extract apiserver audit around change, pull cloud logging KMS decrypt entries, scrub PII/IPs, normalize timestamps, then produce sha256 + gpg.sig. README will include staging->prod mapping and a note about scrubbing.
sanjay: We'll reference vuln ticket RIF-4321 and include a sanitized Slack excerpt. No key rotations during replay.
oncall-bot: Playback executed by sanjay at 2025-04-07T15:12:42Z  evidence bundle created: s3://redwood-audit-temp/1898765433-rbac-kms-bundle.tar.gz (presigned link valid 1h). :white_check_mark:
auditor_jane: Thanks — please DM the presigned link and I'll validate the package once I can access it. :thumbsup:
